name: After § 4
title: REPORT on the control of the financial activities of the European Investment Bank Group – annual report 2024
part_text: 4a. Notes that the 2025 Delegated Act amending Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/10781a opens InvestEU’s ‘strategic investments’ to companies controlled by ‘associated countries’ and non-associated third countries with national guarantees, without requiring rigorous security vetting, thereby exposing the EU guarantee and budget to non-EU interests; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/1774 of 28 August 2025 amending Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/1078 as regards strategic investments in the field of defence set out in the investment guidelines for the InvestEU Fund (OJ L, 2025/1774, 18.12.2025, ELI:[http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg\_del/2025/1774/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_del/2025/1774/oj)).
